results.name: Separate login page per role
results.expected: Three role login cards: Student, Club Manager, Faculty/Admin
results.actual: Cards: student, clubManager, faculty

results.name: Wrong password is rejected
results.actual: "Email or password is incorrect."

results.name: Student account cannot use the Faculty login
results.expected: Error: use the login page for your role
results.actual: "This account is not a Faculty/Admin account. Use the login page for your role."

results.name: Each role lands on its own dashboard
results.input: Log in as student, Dance manager, admin
results.actual: #/dashboard, #/manage, #/faculty

results.name: Session survives refresh and role is visible
results.expected: Navbar pill shows "Priya Sharma · Club Manager · Dance Club"
results.actual:
C
Priya Sharma · Club Manager · Dance Club

results.name: Logged-out visitor is sent to login for a dashboard
results.actual: #/login/student?next=%2Fdashboard

results.name: Student sees all events and all clubs
results.expected: 13 upcoming events, 6 clubs, both rule messages shown
results.actual: 13 events, 6 clubs; rules: "You can join a maximum of 2 clubs." + "You can attend/register for events from any club."

results.name: Register for another club’s event without being a member
results.input: Shruti (no clubs) registers for Open Mic Evening (Music Club)
results.actual: Card: "Your registration: Confirmed / Registered"; dashboard lists Open Mic Evening · Confirmed

results.name: Join max 2 clubs
results.input: Join Dance Club, Music Club, then try Sports Club
results.actual: Sports Club button "Limit reached" (disabled); banner "You've joined 2 of 2"; 2 memberships stored

results.name: Still able to register for a non-member club’s event at the limit
results.input: With 2 clubs, register for Football Cup (Sports Club)
results.actual: Confirmed

results.name: Leave a club frees a slot
results.input: Leave Music Club (confirm), then Sports Club button
results.actual: Sports button: "Join"

results.name: Student dashboard shows everything
results.actual: Sections: registrations, upcoming for you, My clubs (2/2), announcements (university + Dance + Music), following

results.name: Registration needing approval starts Pending
results.actual: Pending approval

results.name: Club Manager accepts a registration
results.input: Music manager → Battle of Bands registrations → Accept
results.actual: Manager saw "Shruti Kushwaha · Pending approval", clicked Accept → Confirmed; student dashboard shows Battle of Bands · Confirmed

results.name: Club Manager rejects a registration and the seat is freed
results.input: Raju registers Open Mic; Music manager rejects
results.expected: Raju sees Rejected; seats filled goes back down
results.actual: Seats filled 50/60 → 49/60; Raju sees "Rejected"

results.name: Club Manager sees only their own club
results.expected: Only Dance Club events, members, announcements
results.actual: club=dance-club; events=annual-dance-fest, dance-workshop; members list includes Shruti Kushwaha

results.name: Club Manager blocked from another club’s management data
results.actual: Music registrations, Music edit URL and /faculty/clubs all blocked

results.name: Invalid event form creates nothing
results.actual: date: Date cannot be in the past; seats: Seats must be at least 1

results.name: Club Manager creates an event
results.input: Dance manager: "Salsa Social Night", valid data
results.expected: Appears on /events hosted by Dance Club
results.actual: Host field: "Dance Club (locked)"; event listed on /events "by Dance Club"

results.name: Club Manager posts an announcement; members see it
results.expected: Shruti (Dance member) sees it on her dashboard
results.actual: Audience "Dance Club members (locked)"; student dashboard shows "Costume fitting"

results.name: Cancelled event shows on the student dashboard
results.input: Shruti registers Annual Dance Fest; Dance manager cancels it (confirm)
results.expected: Dashboard: "Cancelled by organiser"; event page blocks registering
results.actual: Dashboard row: "Annual Dance Fest … Cancelled by organiser"; other student sees "Cancelled" (disabled)

results.name: Faculty/Admin dashboard
results.expected: Stats + links to Clubs, Events, Users, Announcements
results.actual: Stats tiles + 4 management areas shown

results.name: Faculty/Admin can edit any club’s event
results.input: Admin opens Music Club event edit, changes venue
results.expected: Saved; student event page shows new venue
results.actual: Venue now "Open Air Theatre"

results.name: Duplicate club name is rejected
results.actual: "A club with this name already exists"

results.name: Faculty/Admin adds a club
results.actual: Photography Club shown on /clubs

results.name: Faculty/Admin edits club info
results.actual: Updated description visible

results.name: Faculty/Admin creates a user and assigns a club manager
results.input: Create manager "Asha K" for Photography Club
results.expected: Asha can log in and sees only Photography Club
results.actual: Asha logged in → /manage shows "Photography Club"

results.name: Deactivated user cannot log in
results.input: Admin deactivates Raju; Raju tries to log in
results.actual: "This account has been deactivated. Contact the Faculty/Admin office."

results.name: Deleted club disappears everywhere
results.input: Admin deletes Music Club (Shruti is a member)
results.expected: Gone from /clubs and Shruti’s dashboard; its events cancelled; its manager can’t log in
results.actual: Dialog warned "2 upcoming event(s)"; not on /clubs; dashboard My clubs = Dance only; Battle of Bands shows cancelled; manager login refused

results.name: Reduced motion stops the 3D animation
results.input: Emulate prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, open Home, wait 1.5 s
results.actual: reduce → motion=reduced, frames=1 (still 1 after 1 s); switched back → motion=full, frames=24

results.name: Site works without WebGL
results.expected: No canvas, hero/search/featured still render, no errors
results.actual: 0 canvases; hero, search and featured event rendered; 0 page errors

results.input: 375×812 on public, student, manager, faculty pages
results.actual: 17 routes checked at 375 px, all scrollWidth ≤ 375

results.actual: Present on all 7

results.actual: 0 uncaught errors
